figures.name: RBA cash rate target
figures.source: Reserve Bank of Australia
figures.notes: Monetary policy decision of 29 Sep 2026, effective 30 Sep 2026. Fourth increase of 2026 and the highest level since Nov 2011.

figures.name: Average variable rate, new owner-occupier loans
figures.source: RBA Statistical Table F6 (Housing Lending Rates), published 8 Oct 2026
figures.notes: Series FLRHOFVA: new loans funded in the month, owner-occupied, variable rate, all institutions. This month is before the 29 Sep 2026 cash rate increase, so rates on new loans today are likely higher.

figures.name: APRA serviceability buffer
figures.source: Australian Prudential Regulation Authority
figures.notes: Lenders must test that new borrowers could still repay at their loan rate plus at least this buffer. Unchanged since 2021.

figures.name: Average weekly ordinary time earnings, full-time adults
figures.source: ABS Average Weekly Earnings, released 13 Aug 2026
figures.notes: About $108,350 a year. Excludes overtime and covers full-time adult employees only.

figures.name: Consumer Price Index, annual inflation
figures.source: ABS Consumer Price Index, released 30 Sep 2026
figures.notes: Monthly CPI, 12 months to Aug 2026. Trimmed mean inflation was 3.6%. Next release 28 Oct 2026 (Sep 2026 data).

figures.notes: Values fell 1.1% in September, the sixth monthly fall in a row, and are 5.2% below the March 2026 peak.

figures.name: HECS/HELP minimum repayment income, 2026-27
figures.source: Australian Taxation Office
figures.notes: No compulsory repayment below this income. Above it, repayments are charged only on the income over the threshold (marginal system).

figures.name: Resident income tax brackets, 2026-27
figures.source: Australian Taxation Office
figures.notes: The 16% rate became 15% from 1 Jul 2026. Excludes the 2% Medicare levy.

figures.name: First home buyers: no stamp duty up to
figures.source: Revenue NSW, First Home Buyers Assistance Scheme
figures.notes: Eligible first home buyers of a home pay no transfer duty at or below this price.

figures.name: First home buyers: reduced stamp duty below
figures.source: Revenue NSW, First Home Buyers Assistance Scheme
figures.notes: Between $800,000 and $1,000,000 the concession phases out; full duty applies from $1,000,000.

figures.name: Premium property duty threshold
figures.source: Revenue NSW, How to calculate transfer duty
figures.notes: Above this, residential duty is $194,137 plus $7 per $100. Thresholds are CPI-indexed each 1 July.

figures.name: 5% Deposit Scheme price cap: Sydney and NSW regional centres
figures.source: Housing Australia, 5% Deposit Scheme property price caps
figures.notes: Regional centres: Central Coast, Coffs Harbour-Grafton, Illawarra, Mid North Coast, Richmond-Tweed, Newcastle and Lake Macquarie. Checked 25 Oct 2026.

figures.name: 5% Deposit Scheme price cap: rest of NSW
figures.source: Housing Australia, 5% Deposit Scheme property price caps
figures.notes: Minimum deposit 5% (2% for single parents), with no LMI. Checked 25 Oct 2026.
